comment: Vercel deployment config for the React frontend
comment2: What is Vercel? A platform that hosts static websites and frontend apps.
comment3: It detects our Vite/React project, runs 'npm run build', and serves the /dist folder.

rewrites.comment: SPA fallback: ALL URLs → index.html so React Router can handle them.
rewrites.comment2: Without this, refreshing /dashboard would give a 404 from Vercel.
